buyer_added_terms.text: OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Certificates Material Test Certificate Should Be Sent Along with The Supply. The Material Will Be Checked by Buyer’s Lab & the Results of the Lab will be the Sole Criteria for Acceptance of the Item.

9. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Note: Payment term mentioned in the ATC will be only applicable . Payment term mentioned a t Payment Timelines will not be applicable . (1) PQC ;- (i) Bidders should be either Manufacturers or Authorized agent. If bidder is not Manufacturer, then he has to submit the valid Authorization certificate directly from Manufacturer. (ii) Offers of only those bidders shall be considered for technical qualification who themselve s or their OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) possess a valid BIS License for manufacturin g and/or supplying Plywood / Wood . The bidder shall submit a valid copy of the relevant BIS Li cense along with the bid as documentary evidence. (iii) Offers of those parties will be considered who or their Manufacturer has supplied “Plywo od / Wood ” of minimum cumulative value Rs 29.67 Lakhs in last 5 years from the date of tend er opening. The relevant proof of supply (Invoice copy / CRAC etc.) to be submitted with techni cal offer. Note : MSE Manufacturer and Start-ups (Manufacturer of quoted item) are exempted for submi ssion of past experience as per Govt. guidelines. (2) Payment Term: Payments shall be “100% after receipt and acceptance of Material in 90 day s for Non -MSME / in 45 days for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) / in 60 days for Medium Enter prises (MED) as per BHEL, Bhopal norms subjected to Acceptance of Material (SRV) & on-line subm ission of bills (This is in supersession of 10 days’ time as provided in clause 12 of GeM GTC). MSE/MED sellers can avail the intended benefit only if they are manufacturer of offered item (s) an d submit valid MSE/MED certificate (Udyam / NSIC etc.) along with the offer. Note: Payment will be processed only after reflection of the invoice in GSTR 2A/2B data. (3) Please accept all terms and conditions of GEM bid. (4) Early delivery is acceptable. (5) Conflict of Interest as per Annexure-A is applicable for this bid. (6) Any Bidder falling under MSE category shall furnish the following details & submit documentar y evidence/ Govt. Certificate etc. in support of the same along with their techno-commercial offer I. Type under MSE II. SC/ST Owned III. Women Owned IV. Others (excluding SC/ST & Women Owned) V. Micro VI. Small If the bidder does not furnish the above in the tender, offer shall be processed construing that the bidder is not falling under MSE category. (7) Quantity Variation is ± 5% (8) Test Report: Test report / TC to be submitted along with each supply (9) Instruction for seller for supplying of Plywood in Truck/Vehicle :-There should be sufficient spa ce available between Plywood & Truck for applying of sling to lift the plywood by EOT crane for unloading i n Store. The Plywood should be stacked into bundles of about 50 to 70 no. which are secured together wit h strapping bands. Access for ease of handling by EOT cranes to be given by placing wooden bearers acro ss the width of the base of each bundle. Maximum Height of the consignment from ground level should not

exceed 11 Ft. (10) Please submit Annexure-A attached with the bid with Authorized Seal & Sign at each page. (11) Bidder need to submit Conflict of interest attached with the Bid (12) Any amount on account of recovery from consigner/supplier under any condition shall be liable to be adjusted against any amount payable to the consigner/supplier against any running bills. (13) Please submit the Integrity Pact – Annexure-1 along with the bid document, duly signed and sta mped with the Authorized Signatory’s signature and official company seal on every page . . 10.
